title: Why Isn't This Feature the Default? Tech Giants Hesitate #shorts
description: The current situation highlights a clear gap: a critical feature that *should* be the default is conspicuously absent. Despite its undeniable benefits and existing implementation in some technologies, it remains unadopted due to resistance against established commercial models and a reluctance to acknowledge its prevalence. Raising awareness is key to making it an undeniable, universal standard. #TechInnovation #DefaultFeature #DigitalProgress #AwarenessCampaign
